draft.subject: Application for Firmware Engineer Position
draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas, and I hold a Master of Science in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am writing to apply for the Firmware Engineer position with Anki, and my resume is attached to this email.

My background is centered on embedded firmware development in C, including bare metal work at the register level on STM32 microcontrollers, where I programmed GPIO, timer, and ADC peripherals directly while tracking flash and ram usage on a device with very limited memory. I have also used FreeRTOS with mutex based task coordination for sensor integration in real time, and I have designed and fabricated custom PCBs in EAGLE while implementing sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed loop feedback.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
